resources.string: Initial media target: automatic, or 2–10 seconds. The player may start earlier because of live delay or memory limits. Applies when you next open a channel.
Set an initial buffer for each playlist, or follow the global setting. Applies when you next open a channel.
Playback resumes as soon as audio and video can be played, without collecting the initial buffer again.
Forward media target: Balanced 8–10 seconds; Stable 15–17 seconds. A larger initial buffer raises these targets. Actual reserve depends on the stream and memory. Applies on the next channel open.
Set a reserve range for each playlist, or follow the global setting. Applies when you next open a channel.
Choose minimum and maximum reserve targets, for example 8 and 12 seconds. Maximum can be up to 10 seconds above minimum. Applies when you next open a channel.
Live delay for ExoPlayer/HLS, separate from playback reserve. Automatic follows HLS; other players use the source default. Applies on the next channel open.
Set the requested live delay for each playlist, or follow the global setting. Applies when you next open a channel.
A smaller delay places playback closer to the live edge. Some streams may pause more often when new media has not arrived yet.
buffer reserve storage minimum maximum balanced stable refill memory live playback
Effective targets: %1$d–%2$d s. A larger initial buffer raises these targets.
ExoPlayer uses the minimum and maximum; mpv uses the maximum only.
Changes stay in this draft. Done saves; Back cancels.
